## Summary

Implements the critical Pipeline mode constructor slice requested in #127:

- Adds the Pipeline tab after Presentation Mode with the default pre-save short, release, and post-album short scenario.
- Adds the right Pipeline sidebar, save/load controls, active-pipeline persistence, and Pipeline-only sidebar visibility.
- Adds per-stage file selection before the stage number and keeps RUN disabled until every stage is valid and has selected files.
- Adds per-stage video name, action, visualization resolution/preset, publish date, immediate publishing, privacy, and expanded YouTube details.
- Adds release/album metadata with release type, shared cover input, album preset, editable tracks, and drag/drop track ordering.
- Adds confirmed stage deletion, first-use timezone selection, Pipeline settings timezone editing, and post-run reset with remembered checkbox choices plus a 600 ms hold action.
- Preserves PR #126 upload-form memory by scoping YouTube modal state per pipeline stage.
- Merges latest upstream `main` so the branch includes PR #108's batch visualization work for later album execution wiring.

The RUN action currently validates and marks the pipeline ready for sequential execution. Durable long-running render/upload execution should be wired after Electron-safe file-path persistence and runner orchestration are finalized.

## Screenshot

![Implemented Pipeline mode](https://github.com/konard/Jhon-Crow-audio-recorder-with-visualization/blob/issue-127-9c107db5dfa0/docs/case-studies/issue-127/screenshots/pipeline-mode-implemented.png?raw=true)

## Verification

- `npm ci`
- `npm test` - 9 suites / 335 tests passed
- `npm run typecheck`
- `npm run lint`
- `npm run build`
- `node --check examples/pipeline.js`
- `node --check examples/youtube-upload.js`
- `npx cypress run --spec cypress/e2e/pipeline-mode.cy.js` - 5/5 passed
- `npx cypress run --spec cypress/e2e/youtube-upload-ui.cy.js` - 10/10 passed
- `npx cypress run` - 9 specs / 42 tests passed

Fixes Jhon-Crow/audio-recorder-with-visualization#127
